stem.en: You mix 4.20 g of baking soda with 10.00 g of vinegar in an open flask. When the fizzing stops, the contents of the flask weigh 12.00 g. What mass of gas left the flask, in g?

explanation.en: The total mass at the start is 4.20 + 10.00 = 14.20 g. The flask now holds 12.00 g, and matter is not destroyed, so the missing 14.20 - 12.00 = 2.20 g must be the gas that escaped through the open mouth.

hints.en: Add up the mass at the start. The mass is not destroyed, so where did the difference go?
